title: Discovering our families
summary: Review different families, family relationships and helping at home.
keyIdeas: Families can be different. Everyone deserves care and respect.
We help at home according to our age and what we can do.
Memories from relatives and people close to us help us learn about the past.

basicKnowledge: C. Sociedades y territorios › Sociedades en el tiempo
C. Sociedades y territorios › Alfabetización cívica

activities.explanation: There are many different families. Each is unique.

activities.prompt: Match each person to their family relationship.
activities.explanation: Family words describe how people are related.
Love and respect are important in families.
activities.sentence: In a family, caring for each other and showing ___ matter most.

activities.prompt: Sort these tasks by who can do them at home.
activities.explanation: Adults do dangerous tasks. Young children can help with simple tidying.

items.text: Use a hot iron on clothes

activities.prompt: Lucas sees his father sweeping the living room. What can Lucas do?
activities.explanation: Helping with household tasks makes living together easier.
activities.hint: Think about helping finish the task.
options: Drop more paper on the floor
Help pick up toys from the floor

activities.prompt: Put these life stages in order from the beginning.
activities.explanation: We are born as babies and grow over time.

activities.prompt: Only mothers should wash dishes and cook.
activities.explanation: Tasks do not depend on being a man or woman. They are shared according to each person's age and abilities.

activities.prompt: What happens when everyone at home helps?
activities.explanation: Sharing tasks can give us more time to enjoy together.
activities.hint: Think about the benefits of teamwork.
options: We have more free time to enjoy together
The home becomes messier and dirtier
Nobody knows which task to do

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence about family history.
activities.explanation: Older people's memories help us learn about the past.
activities.sentence: Grandparents tell stories about the past using their ___.

activities.prompt: Read carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Family photographs can show us how people lived in the past.
activities.title: Martina's photo album
activities.text: Martina looks at a photo album with her grandfather Luis. An old photo shows Luis as a child playing with spinning tops. Martina smiles and shows him her favourite building-block game. They enjoy sharing their stories.

questions.prompt: What did Grandpa Luis play with as a child?
questions.explanation: The text says he played with spinning tops.

questions.prompt: What do Martina and her grandfather discover from the photos?
questions.explanation: Old photographs show how life changes over time.
options: Nobody played at home in the past
